lines.h1: Structured or Todoist? Here's the answer in ten seconds.
lines.h2: Lose track of time, and need to see your day as blocks? Structured.
lines.h3: Tasks slip out of your head, and you juggle lots of projects? Todoist.
lines.h4: Now, five rounds to prove it. Plus one bonus round, where a third app comes in.
lines.r1b: Structured draws your day as one line. A thirty-minute task is taller than a fifteen-minute one, so you can see when a day won't fit.
lines.r1c: Todoist has a calendar layout, but it starts from lists.
lines.r1d: For time blindness, round to Structured.
lines.r2a: Round two. Getting tasks out of your head.
lines.r2b: Todoist's Quick Add reads a plain sentence and sets the date and the repeat. And Ramble lets you just talk.
lines.r2c: Structured has an inbox, but every task still needs a place on the timeline.
lines.r3b: Todoist holds whole projects, with sections, sub-tasks, priorities and filters.
lines.r3c: Structured is built around today. It shows one day beautifully, not a three-month project.
lines.r4b: Structured has a focus timer built in, and the countdown sits right on your lock screen.
lines.r4c: Todoist doesn't have one. You'd add another app.
lines.r5a: Round five. Works on every device.
lines.r5b: Todoist runs on iPhone, Android, Mac, Windows, Linux and the web.
lines.r5c: Structured covers Apple devices, Android and the web, but not Windows or Linux.
lines.r5d: If you live on a Windows computer, round to Todoist.
lines.sc: Todoist wins on points. But if losing track of time is your real problem, Structured is the one.
lines.b1: One more round. The moment you freeze on a task you've been avoiding.
lines.b2: Structured gives it a time slot. Todoist gives it a place on the list. Neither makes you start.
lines.f1: Full disclosure, that's the gap we built FOCO for. It starts from the task you're putting off.
lines.f2: It breaks the task into tiny steps, each with a time estimate.
lines.f3: Then step one opens into a focus session, with a timer and a companion working next to you.
lines.o1: So. Structured to see your day as time. Todoist to catch every task and project.
lines.o2: And FOCO when the plan is fine, but you still can't begin. Tell me in the comments which one you are.
